extendedinputbox-default-title: Default popup dialog title, used when "popup-title" is not set on the <inputbox>.
extendedinputbox-btn-save: Label of the button that submits the popup form.
extendedinputbox-btn-cancel: Label of the button that cancels/closes the popup form.
extendedinputbox-default-pagename: Default target page name, used when no "page=" parameter and no field value can be resolved.
extendedinputbox-default-username: Fallback value for the {{USER}}/{{REVISIONUSER}} magic words when no user is logged in.
extendedinputbox-error-unresolved-title:
Error shown when the generated page title still contains unresolved template braces. Parameters:
* $1 - the generated (invalid) title
extendedinputbox-error-preload-fetch:
Error shown when the preload template could not be fetched during a skip-edit publication. Parameters:
* $1 - the preload template title that failed to load
extendedinputbox-error-publish:
Error shown when the MediaWiki API returns an error while publishing a page via skip-edit. Parameters:
* $1 - the API error message
extendedinputbox-error-popup-preload-dep: Error shown when the deprecated "popup-preload" parameter is used in an <inputbox> configuration.
extendedinputbox-error-invalid-bgcolor: Error shown when "button-bgcolor" is not a valid CSS color.
extendedinputbox-error-invalid-bordercol: Error shown when "button-border-color" is not a valid CSS color.
extendedinputbox-error-duplicate-field:
Error shown when the same field name is used in more than one "popup-field" parameter within a single <inputbox>. Parameters:
* $1 - the duplicated field name
extendedinputbox-required-marker: Default short marker appended to a field's label when it is required ("required=yes" on "popup-field"). It can be overridden per form with "required-marker=" or "popup-required-marker=".
extendedinputbox-error-field-required:
Error shown when a required field ("required=yes" on "popup-field") is left empty at submission time. Parameters:
* $1 - the field's label
extendedinputbox-special: Name/description of Special:Extended-Inputbox shown on Special:SpecialPages.
extendedinputbox-special-intro: Short introductory text shown at the top of Special:Extended-Inputbox.
extendedinputbox-special-section-general: Heading of the panel with the general <inputbox> parameters (type, page, buttonlabel, etc.).
extendedinputbox-special-section-fields: Heading of the panel listing the popup-field rows of the form being built.
extendedinputbox-special-section-target: Heading of the panel used to load, edit, preview and publish the target page.
extendedinputbox-special-field-type: Label of the dropdown selecting the InputBox "type=" parameter (search, create, comment, move).
extendedinputbox-special-field-page: Label of the text field for the InputBox "page=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-special-field-prefix: Label of the text field for the InputBox "prefix=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-special-field-default: Label of the text field for the InputBox "default=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-special-field-buttonlab: Label of the text field for the InputBox "buttonlabel=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-special-field-preload: Label of the text field for the InputBox "preload=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-special-field-preloadpa: Label of the text field for the "preload-params=" parameter (comma-separated field names).
extendedinputbox-special-field-summary: Label of the text field for the InputBox "summary=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-special-field-popuptitl: Label of the text field for the "popup-title=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-special-field-popuptext: Label of the text field for the "popup-text=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-special-field-requiredm: Label of the text field for the "required-marker=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-special-field-hidemarke: Label of the checkbox that forces an empty "required-marker=" value (hides the marker entirely).
extendedinputbox-special-field-skipedit: Label of the checkbox for the "skip-edit=yes" parameter.
extendedinputbox-special-field-bgcolor: Label of the text field for the "button-bgcolor=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-special-field-bordercol: Label of the text field for the "button-border-color=" parameter.
extendedinputbox-special-type-none: Dropdown option meaning the "type=" parameter is left unset.
extendedinputbox-special-field-row-name: Placeholder of the "name" text input inside a popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-special-field-row-label: Placeholder of the "label" text input inside a popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-special-field-row-optio: Placeholder of the "options" text input inside a popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-special-field-row-showi: Placeholder of the "show-if" text input inside a popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-special-field-row-requi: Label of the "required" checkbox inside a popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-special-field-type-text: Field type option: single-line text input.
Field type option: multi-line text input.
extendedinputbox-special-btn-addfield: Label of the button that adds a new popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-special-btn-removefield: Label of the button that removes a popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-special-btn-moveup: Label of the button that moves a popup-field row up.
extendedinputbox-special-btn-movedown: Label of the button that moves a popup-field row down.
extendedinputbox-special-no-fields: Placeholder text shown in the fields list when no popup-field has been added yet.
extendedinputbox-special-drag-hint: Tooltip on the drag handle of a popup-field row.
extendedinputbox-special-generated-label: Heading above the read-only textarea showing the generated <inputbox> block.
extendedinputbox-special-field-target-ti: Placeholder of the title input used to choose the target page to load.
extendedinputbox-special-btn-load: Label of the button that fetches the target page's wikitext via the API.
extendedinputbox-special-btn-insert: Label of the button that inserts the generated wikitext at the cursor position.
extendedinputbox-special-btn-preview: Label of the button that renders a preview of the target page's current wikitext.
extendedinputbox-special-btn-publish: Label of the button that saves the target page via the API.
extendedinputbox-special-wikitext-label: Placeholder of the textarea containing the target page's wikitext.
extendedinputbox-special-preview-label: Heading above the rendered HTML preview of the target page.
extendedinputbox-special-preview-loading: Placeholder text shown while the preview is being fetched from the API.
extendedinputbox-special-notice-newpage: Notice shown after loading a target page that does not exist yet.
extendedinputbox-special-notice-loaded: Notice shown after successfully loading the target page's wikitext.
extendedinputbox-special-notice-inserted: Notice shown after inserting the generated wikitext into the target textarea.
extendedinputbox-special-notice-publishe: Notice shown after successfully saving the target page, just before redirecting to it.
extendedinputbox-special-error-notitle: Error shown when trying to load a page without having entered a title.
extendedinputbox-special-error-load:
Error shown when the API call to load the target page fails. Parameters:
* $1 - the API error message or the page title
extendedinputbox-special-error-preview:
Error shown when the action=parse API call fails. Parameters:
* $1 - the API error message
extendedinputbox-special-error-publish:
Error shown when the action=edit API call fails for a reason other than a permission problem. Parameters:
* $1 - the API error message
extendedinputbox-special-error-noedit: Generic error shown when the current user cannot edit the target page and no detailed reason could be retrieved from the API.
extendedinputbox-special-error-noedit-de:
Error shown when the current user cannot edit the target page, including the specific reason returned by the MediaWiki API (protection, block, read-only mode, abuse filter, etc.). Parameters:
* $1 - the detailed reason, already translated by the API (errorformat=plaintext)
extendedinputbox-special-error-editconfl: Error shown when publishing fails because the target page was edited by someone else since it was loaded (edit conflict). Should invite the user to reload the page.
extendedinputbox-special-btn-copy: Label of the button that copies the generated wikitext to the clipboard.
extendedinputbox-special-notice-copied: Transient confirmation shown next to the copy button after a successful clipboard copy.
extendedinputbox-special-error-copy-fail: Transient error shown next to the copy button when the clipboard copy failed (e.g. insecure context, permission denied).
extendedinputbox-special-warning-incompl:
Live validation warning shown under the generated wikitext when a popup-field row is missing its name and/or label, meaning it is silently skipped when generating the wikitext. Parameters:
* $1 - the 1-based position of the incomplete field row
extendedinputbox-special-status-loading: Transient status text shown next to the "Load page" button while the target page is being fetched.
extendedinputbox-special-status-previewi: Transient status text shown next to the "Load page" button while a preview is being generated.
extendedinputbox-special-status-publishi: Transient status text shown next to the "Load page" button while the target page is being saved.
extendedinputbox-special-error-noinsert: Error shown when trying to insert, preview or publish before a target page has been loaded.
extendedinputbox-special-confirm-overwri: Confirmation dialog shown before publishing changes to an already-existing page.
extendedinputbox-special-summary-default: Default edit summary used when publishing from Special:Extended-Inputbox without a custom "summary=" value.
extendedinputbox-special-advanced-toggle: Label of the collapsible <details> section grouping the less commonly used general settings (required marker, button colors, skip-edit).
extendedinputbox-special-btn-previewpopu: Label of the button that opens a read-only preview dialog reproducing the popup as currently configured, without publishing anything.
extendedinputbox-error-filter:
Label shown before an AbuseFilter message. Parameters:
* $1 - the filter number
extendedinputbox-special-preview-popup-b: Banner shown at the top of the popup preview dialog, clarifying that it is non-functional (no save/publish happens from it).
extendedinputbox-special-field-requiredm: Placeholder of the "required marker" text field in the advanced options.
extendedinputbox-special-warning-pipe-in:
Live validation warning: a popup-field row contains a pipe character. Parameters:
* $1 - the 1-based position of the field row
extendedinputbox-error-page-exists:
Error shown when publishing would overwrite an existing page while creating. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title
extendedinputbox-confirm-skipedit:
Confirmation shown before a skip-edit publication. Parameters:
* $1 - the target page title
extendedinputbox-error-skipedit-forbidde:
Error shown when skip-edit targets a sensitive page (MediaWiki namespace, .js/.css/.json). Parameters:
* $1 - the target page title
